_comment: Source for `vexpo asc accessibility lint` and `push`. One entry per device family, nine booleans, anything left out is false. Apple's bar is task-based, so re-check every feature against your own screens before you push. `notes` is ours, not Apple's. Add a top-level `url` (https) to set the accessibility link on the product page.

entries.notes: iPhone only, captions and audio descriptions off because nothing plays media. One caveat: userInterfaceStyle is automatic, so an app set to Dark under a Light system flashes white on launch, and the accessibility URL is where Apple wants that explained. Verified against the source, not on a device, so re-check with VoiceOver before you ship.
